title: Gordon Cooper, Mercury astronaut, among pilots who saw UFOs

tellings.quote: you have Gordon Cooper who uh, you know, was one of the first American astronauts who spent more time in space.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, names Gordon Cooper among the pilots who have seen UFOs. Cooper was one of the first American astronauts, part of Mercury, the first US programme to send people into space, and Michels says he spent more time in space than the others. He brings Cooper up because, if true, it would mean some of the most trusted flyers in the country have seen these things.
